charts.title: TOI-431 d: orbits around TOI-431
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-431's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-431 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Osborn et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.507.2782O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname OSBORN_ET_AL__2021): P 12.46103 d
